properties.site-address: Former Initial Textile Services, bounded by Botany Brow and Willow Road, Chorley
properties.notes: Amendments to previously approved planning applications on this site (ref: 13/00993/FULMAJ relating to the approved residential development and 14/00717/FUL relating to the employment/ commercial building) which will result in 43 dwellings on the site and a larger employment/ commercial area. Planning Ref: 11/00871/FULMAJ (2013-07-31); 12/01015/FULMAJ (2013-08-05); 13/00993/FULMAJ (2014-01-15); 14/01225/MNMA (2014-12-08); 15/00028/FUL (2015-03-18); 16/00053/FUL (2016-03-02). 33 dwellings left to be built at March 2019, none of which were under construction.
